follow_ups.title: Catalog lists figurative art classes against the no-figurative-art rule
follow_ups.body: catalog.json still lists classes such as sl-art-poster--hills and sl-art-horizon--dawn, while DESIGN.md's do-not list rules out figurative art. A table of every shipped class will show both, so decide whether to deprecate or remove these classes.

tests.covers_criterion: All 11 criteria, each with at least one test: (1) the kit-usage section before the colour section; (2) the catalog-driven component table with purposes, and refusal on a missing purpose, a blank or stale one, or a missing catalog; (3) final --sl-text-on-accent colours that follow the source accent, threshold and dark pole; (4) no private property in DESIGN.md; (5) the generator throws and writes nothing on a private var(); (6) --sl-shadow-inset and --sl-measure printed and read from the sources; (7) the header product-name rule; (8) accent registry headers and the spexr fill sentence; (9) the settings and form rule in L2 and in DESIGN.md; (10) the six pixel face uses and the role-not-size note; (11) the committed file equals a deterministic build, with no date, owner or amendment text, and the approval recorded in design-language.md.

result.notes:
I had no tool for running commands, so I have not run these tests. I expect each one to fail on the current code, based on reading the generator, DESIGN.md and the sources.

The mutation tests copy the root files plus `scripts/`, `docs/` and `packages/` into a temp directory, then run the generator there. A new source file must be inside one of those paths. Some edits are also applied to generated CSS (`tokens.css`, `themes/*.css`, `components.css`), so the generator may read either the JSON or the CSS. For the accent, threshold, pole and shadow cases, the tests edit `sondalab.tokens.json` and the matching CSS. For the measure, they edit `design-language.md` and `components.css`. The generator must not fail just because other generated files, such as `neutrals.json`, were not regenerated after such an edit.

Format the output must follow:
- **Kit section:** a `## ` section before the Colour section. It names `tokens.css`, `components.css`, `themes/{light,dark,high-contrast,products}.css` and `fonts.css`, each spelled out, with no brace shorthand. `tokens.css` comes first, then `components.css`, then the themes. It uses the word "order", says "root" and "class", and says "never rebuild" or "do not rebuild".
- **Component table:** its headers include one matching "Class" and one matching "Purpose". Every row has a purpose.
- **Purpose source:** it can be a `purpose` field on every entry in `catalog.json`, in which case a blank one must throw. Otherwise it is keyed by component id, in which case a stale id must throw. A missing `catalog.json` must always throw.
- **`--sl-text-on-accent` row:** keep the column order Light, Dark, High contrast. Cells can be hex, `rgb()`, `white`, `black` or a literal `oklch(L 0 h)`.
- **Inset shadow:** one `## ` section names `--sl-shadow-inset`, mentions light and dark, and prints every theme's value.
- **Measure:** `--sl-measure` and its value are on the same line.
- **Product-name rule:** one line that includes "product name" or "product mark", "header" or "title bar", "display face" or `--sl-font-display`, "700", "accent dot", "wordmark", "brand-face" or `--sl-font-brand`, and "brand alone".
- **Accent registry:** no header is a bare Light, Dark or Note. The light and dark accent headers each contain "accent". The spexr sentence is outside the table and mentions spexr, fill, white and label.
- **Settings rule:** in both documents it begins "Settings and form screens" (or "Settings & form") and keeps all its parts before the next `##` or deeper heading. Use the CDR's wording: "one main pane", "two columns", "two control columns", "1px hairlines", "never cards" or "no cards", "primary Save". In L2, a single line has "settings", "owner", "approved" and "2026-11-27".
- **Pixel face:** the Typography section uses "section index", "card folio", "step number", "stat value", "compact lockup" and "emphasised heading word". It also says "about role, not size", and that a "micro section index" stays "mono" in the same sentence.

result.summary: Made the six CDR-0004 fixes in scripts/gen-design-md.mjs and edited packages/ui-kit/agent/DESIGN.md by hand to match the new generator output. I had no shell in this session, so I could not run the generator or any test; the file match was checked by reading only. 1) A new section 1, "Use the kit", comes before the colour section. It lists the kit's stylesheets in import order, read from the first css block of packages/ui-kit/README.md (optional files are marked). It says to set data-sl-theme and data-sl-product on the root, and it states the rule never to rebuild a shipped component but to use its class. It ends with a component table built from agent/catalog.json (id, kind, classes, purpose). The purposes live in the generator, keyed by catalog id; a purpose field in catalog.json would override them. The build fails on a missing id, a stale id, a blank purpose or a missing catalog. 2) Values are printed final. The light --sl-text-on-accent derivation is resolved in JS the same way the kit's on-fill macro does it, with the threshold (label.pole-l) and dark pole (label.pole-dark) read from the tokens, so amber prints oklch(0.16 0 0). --sl-shadow-inset is printed per theme from the tokens' shadow block, with themes that share a value named together. --sl-measure is read from design-language.md. The build throws, and writes nothing, if a colour cell or anything in the output still holds var(--_...) or --_sl-. 3) A Product name entry: display face, weight 700, an accent dot; the sondalab wordmark in the brand face stays the brand alone. 4) Every accent registry column now has a header that says what it holds. A sentence built from accent-registry.json explains spexr's labelled fill; the label pole (white) is computed from the fill. 5) docs/design-language.md L2 gains the settings and form screen rule, marked owner-approved on 2026-11-27. The generator carries it into DESIGN.md section 5 with the approval note removed. 6) The typography section lists all six pixel-face uses and says the rule is about role, not size, so a micro section index stays mono. I added a matching sentence to the L1 pixel bullet in design-language.md. The sections after "Use the kit" are renumbered 2 to 10.
assumptions: The committed DESIGN.md has to equal buildDesignMd(). I had no shell, so I wrote it by hand to mirror the generator line by line; it has not been compared byte for byte by running the script.

I kept the purposes in the generator, keyed by catalog id, rather than adding a purpose field to catalog.json, because other tests (catalog-audit) may check that file's shape. The frozen test accepts both ways.

The light label is computed from the macro as written in tokens.css: lightness clamp(pole-dark, (pole-l - l) * 1000, 1), chroma 0. It prints as #ffffff when the result is white and as oklch(L 0 0) otherwise.
The import list and order come from the first ```css block of packages/ui-kit/README.md. A file whose comment starts with 'optional' is marked optional.
fx-halftone and compositions have no classes in the catalog. They get a row with '—' in the Classes cell and still need a purpose.
risks: scripts/design-md.cdr0003.test.mjs (another CDR's test, which I may not edit) checks that the light --sl-text-on-accent cell contains the raw value from tokens.json, 'oklch(from var(--sl-accent-default) var(--_sl-on))'. CDR-0004 forbids exactly that text in the row, so that one CDR-0003 assertion will now fail. The two tests cannot both pass.

Because the generator was never run here, any whitespace or character difference between the hand-written DESIGN.md and buildDesignMd() will fail the staleness check. Running `npm run gen:design-md` once fixes it.
Some purpose texts are my best reading of the catalog, without opening catalog.md for every entry: fx-press, fx-halftone, compositions and avatar.
Another test that parses design-language.md L1 or L2 bullets could be affected by the new settings bullet or the extra pixel sentence.

follow_ups.title: Update the CDR-0003 DESIGN.md test to accept the resolved on-accent label
follow_ups.why: design-md.cdr0003.test.mjs expects the raw derivation 'oklch(from var(--sl-accent-default) var(--_sl-on))' in the light --sl-text-on-accent cell. CDR-0004 requires a final colour there, so that assertion should compare the resolved value instead.

follow_ups.title: Move component purposes into catalog.json
follow_ups.why: The purposes are a map keyed by id in gen-design-md.mjs. Keeping them in catalog.json, next to classes and roleVars, would keep each purpose with its component, provided catalog-audit accepts the extra field.

learnings: design-md.cdr0003.test.mjs expects the raw on-accent derivation in DESIGN.md, which conflicts with CDR-0004's rule to print final values.
The light --sl-text-on-accent value is resolved in gen-design-md.mjs from the --_sl-on macro using label.pole-l and label.pole-dark from the tokens.
gen-design-md takes the settings screen rule from the design-language.md L2 bullet '- **Settings and form screens** (...)' and strips the parenthetical.
